text.en:
The Auitan Barangay High School in the Municipality of San Pablo, Province of Isabela, is
hereby converted into a vocational and industrial high school to be known as St. Paul Vocational and
Industrial High School.

The operation and maintenance of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be
funded out of local funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding
fiscal years shall be provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 24, 1983
